input: Select an interface and generation for live operations. Record within explicit byte and entry limits. Export sealed files by byte offset. Upload archives in bounded base64 chunks under the initiating credential. Replay with an entry cursor and optional elapsed microseconds. Descriptor search and monitor filters accept an explicit observation source, cursor and bounded page size. Continuations fence mutable observations by fingerprint.
output: Returns native descriptor provenance, exact raw and decoded observations, ordered loss and terminal markers, recording limits and archived source generation. Deterministic replay returns observations at the selected clock. Inspection and report slices recover oversized evidence. GET slices retain the original request identity.
effect: An explicit recording retains subsequent deliveries independently of display refresh. Stop seals the retained prefix. Discard releases it. Imported replays are isolated from live acquisition and routing.
guard: Authenticated reads inspect metadata, status, bounded archive slices and replay pages. Recording and upload lifecycle changes require write scope. Native device access policy remains authoritative. A chunk retry must match the original bytes at its offset.
lifecycle: Replay handles and uploads belong to the initiating client. Closing a live capture seals its recording. A sealed recording remains exportable by its original generation until discarded. Close a replay or cancel an upload to release its storage. Credential revocation retires owned receivers, seals owned recordings on borrowed receivers, and releases private replays and uploads.
scenario: Running dev Cockpit acceptance drives discovery, inspection, receive, recording and replay through authenticated MCP. The Debug view shares a native generation with the external client. Authored fixtures compare decoded data and exercise search, filters, paging, slice recovery and denied/stale requests.

workflow: Inspect vJoy slots and received force-feedback requests
mcp: controller_vjoy_debug_inspect; controller_vjoy_debug_open; controller_vjoy_debug_read; controller_vjoy_debug_close; controller_vjoy_debug_record_start; controller_vjoy_debug_record_stop; controller_vjoy_debug_export; controller_vjoy_debug_replay
input: Select a slot (1–16), then open an available force-feedback receiver. Read by generation and decimal sequence. Replay accepts a bounded raw callback archive.
output: The native service returns SDK capabilities, ordered raw callback bytes, decoded PID requests, observed effect state and explicit capture errors.
effect: Inspect reads SDK metadata. Open starts receive-only acquisition. Start and stop retain a bounded recording. Export saves the sealed prefix. Replay decodes it offline.
guard: Write credentials are required to acquire a slot or change a recording. Only the owning client can close its generation. Read credentials can inspect, observe, export and replay.
lifecycle: A capture has one owner. Closing, revocation and shutdown release its helper. A full recording seals its observed prefix; export it before closing.
scenario: tests/ui/vjoy-debug-native.mjs compares the running Debug view with authenticated MCP for authored replay, device inspection and installed slot outcomes.
